summary: Iter 98 · Comprehensive test of the new JWT-based single email+password login that replaced the persona-chip demo. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases green (all 7 seeded accounts log in, wrong password / unknown email both return generic 401 with identical detail, /auth/me handles valid/missing/malformed/expired tokens correctly, bcrypt $2b$ hash + unique email index verified in Mongo, stateless /auth/logout works, protected /api/members still accepts Bearer + persona headers together). Frontend: 7/7 flows green (login page structure with only 4 interactive elements & zero persona chips, wrong-password error UX, password toggle, successful login → /dashboard with eyJ token + secretary persona in localStorage, hard-reload persistence via /auth/me, 401 interceptor bounce to /login after token wipe, axios sends both Authorization: Bearer and X-Body-Code/X-Persona-Post on protected calls).
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext hydration only runs on mount for the case (token exists && !persona). If a stale token is present alongside a stale persona (from a rotated user), stale persona is trusted until next 401. Consider unconditionally calling /auth/me on mount when a token exists to refresh the persona.

PERSONAS list in AuthContext.jsx still contains the full seed with 'match-official' incorrectly excluded from isOfficeBearer (only 5 ids allowlisted). If office-bearer semantics should include match-official/district-secretary, verify the whitelist matches business intent.
seed_users.py stores a legacy 'match-official' but is_active/role checks are absent — acceptable since login endpoint honours is_active. LGTM overall.
Password reset / forgot-password flow is not implemented — acceptable for MVP but worth flagging for future scope.
No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login. For an ERP with only 7 accounts this is a real concern; consider adding a simple failed-attempt counter or fail2ban-style throttle.
test_credentials: Any of the 7 accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; primary: secretary@mpca.in / mpca@2026. All 7 verified logging in.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded office-bearer users (idempotent boot-time seeder).
context_for_next_testing_agent: JWT auth (login/me/logout) is working end-to-end. api.js interceptor injects both Bearer and legacy persona headers so existing header-based RBAC continues to work. localStorage keys: mpca_token (JWT) + mpca_persona (user JSON). 401 on any non-auth endpoint auto-logs-out and redirects to /login. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter98_jwt_auth.py can be re-run as a regression.
rca of the issue: No issue — all requested backend and frontend scenarios passed on first execution.
